newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT - Dizzy notionnel may reach 129.52 top.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT - Dizzy notionnel may reach 129.52 top.

text.p: MATIF September notionnel futures spiked higher on Wednesday and technical analysts said the market, dragged by strong Bunds, could hike to the June 16 top of 129.52.
But Charles Diebel, senior fixed income analyst at Technical Data in London, said daily momentum indicators were gloomy and the odds for direction were 50-50 now.
"The overall picture is not as constructive as in Bunds," Diebel said, adding that if the pivotal level of 128.80 failed, losses could be extended to 128.42, the low on June 20.
By 0740 GMT, September notionnel were 0.26 higher at 129.12.
If 129.12 is taken out, 129.52 will be viable, Diebel said.
"With Bunds constructive I guess you've got to favour the upside," he said.

Richard Adcock, technical research manager at HSBC Futures in London, said in a note prices appeared to have aborted the downside potential and the latest rally looked like a bullish continuation pattern from which further strength could develop.
"Short term pullbacks under the figure (129.00) should be well-supported," he said, adding attacks to 129.52 were expected. Stops should be placed at 128.64, he said.
September Pibor futures were up 0.03 at 96.59.
